name: Probe R22 D
mExpression: let Raw = AnalysisServices.Database("SSASPROD","BIQLTabular",[ Query = "EVALUATE SELECTCOLUMNS( FILTER( 'Currency Rates', 'Currency Rates'[CurrencyCodeFrom] = ""EUR"" && 'Currency Rates'[CurrencyCodeTo] = ""USD"" && 'Currency Rates'[CalendarDate] = 'Currency Rates'[PeriodEndDate] && 'Currency Rates'[CalendarDate] >= DATE(2019,1,1) ), ""PeriodEnd"", 'Currency Rates'[PeriodEndDate], ""RateDaily"", 'Currency Rates'[ToRateDaily], ""RateA"", 'Currency Rates'[ToRateA], ""RateM"", 'Currency Rates'[ToRateM], ""RateB"", 'Currency Rates'[ToRateB] )" ]), Data = Table.TransformColumnNames(Raw, each if Text.StartsWith(_, "[") and Text.EndsWith(_, "]") then Text.Middle(_, 1, Text.Length(_) - 2) else _) in Data
